text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League clash between West Ham and Everton.
West Ham return to Premier League action after losing to Olympiakos in the Europa League during the week.
David Moyes’ men started the season strongly and collected three wins and one draw in their opening four games, with their victory against Luton Town propelling them to the top of the table.
However, the Hammers have only triumphed in one of their last five games, losing three times.
They lost 4-1 to Aston Villa in their previous league outing and have dropped down to ninth position.
However, West Ham will be confident that they can return to winning ways against Everton as they have won four of their last six league matches against them.
Everton were beaten by bitter rivals Liverpool in the Merseyside derby in their last outing, with Mohamed Salah scoring twice in a 2-0 win for the Reds.
The Toffees had won two of their previous three league games before losing at Anfield, with impressive wins over Brentford and Bournemouth coming either side of a 2-1 defeat against Luton.
Their recent upturn in results was required, with Everton collecting just one point from their first five games.
Sean Dyche's side are just two places and two points above the relegation zone.
West Ham make two changes to the side that lost to Villa in their last Premier League match.
Cresswell returns from injury to make his first start of the season and replaces Emerson Palmieri at left-back, with the former Chelsea defender out through suspension.
Kudus also comes in for Soucek.
Everton only make one alteration to the team that was beaten by Liverpool.
Ashley Young was sent off in the Merseyside derby, meaning Patterson comes in at right-back.
Everton have lost more Premier League away games against London sides than any other side (87).
They did, however, win their last visit to the capital (3-1 v Brentford), last winning back-to-back such matches in May 2021 (the second of which was against West Ham).
The teams are on the pitch and are paying their respect to Bill Kenwright and Sir Bobby Charlton.
This Premier League clash is under way.
Everton will want to start the game quickly to boost the morale around the club after a difficult week.
They are also facing a deduction of 12 points due to alleged breaches of financial rules.
West Ham have started the game well and are keeping possession.
Ward-Prowse rolls the ball across to Cresswell, who slides a throughball down the wing.
Antonio races down the channel to get there but pokes it behind for a goal-kick.
Garner switches the play over to the left, with McNeil controlling it well.
He is up against Coufal and looks to go past him before flashing a low cross into the box that is collected by Areola.
West Ham are focusing their attacks down the left.
Antonio approaches the byline and beats Patterson on the outside before driving a cross into the heart of the box.
However, Onana is there and he clears it away.
CHANCE! West Ham are keeping the ball well around the box.
Kudus drops the ball off to Paqueta, who dinks a pass over the top of Everton's defence and into the path of Bowen.
However, he cannot get there and Pickford gets there to divert it away.
Cresswell is over a free-kick on the left and he sends an inviting cross into the box.
Bowen attacks it but gets his header all wrong.
Doucoure then clears it behind for a corner.
Mykolenko has possession just inside Everton's half.
He attempts to send an early pass through to Calvert-Lewin, but the striker is offside.
Coufal sends a throw-in from the right into the box.
Zouma climbs to get his head on it, but the centre-back loops his effort straight into the gloves of Pickford.
Kudus is starting his first game in the Premier League and has shown some promising signs with some nice touches in Everton's half.
He looks to win the ball off Tarkowski but goes through the back of the defender and gives away a free-kick.
Zouma drives a pass into the feet of Kudus, who skips past Branthwaite before being tripped by the Everton man.
There have been a lot of small fouls in the middle of the pitch that has stopped the game from being able to flow.
Harrison and Patterson combine down the right, with the latter of the two whipping a cross into the heart of the box.
McNeil gets on the end of it and tries to poke a pass through to Calvert-Lewin, but the striker is offside.
West Ham pass the ball around the middle third of the pitch, with Kudus, Paqueta and Alvarez all involved.
Cresswell then receives it on the left but sends his pass straight out for a throw-in.
WIDE! What a chance for West Ham.
Paqueta controls the ball on the left before flicking it over the head of Patterson.
He then sends a pass across the box to Bowen, who misses the target with a first-time effort.
SAVE! Everton have a chance of their own.
Paqueta gifts the ball to Harrison, with the Everton man driving the ball forward.
He approaches the box and has options on his left and right but sends his low shot straight at Areola.
Tarkowski makes a strong challenge on Kudus and players from both teams get involved in a scuffle.
The referee stops the game and yellow cards are about to come out.
Pickford rushes out of his goal and is booked for his part in the altercation.
Kudus was on the end of Tarkowski's tackle and goes into the book for his reaction.
Paqueta attempts to curl a first-time pass over the top of Everton's defence and through to a team-mate, but the ball goes back to Pickford.
The away side then gift possession back to West Ham after trying to rush an attack forward.
Everton are looking to put the ball into the box when they get down the wings.
This time Mykolenko searches for Calvert-Lewin with an early ball in, but his attempt is blocked by Aguerd.
Doucoure wins a corner off Zouma.
Tarkowski gets there first inside the box, but his downward header is blocked.
Onana wins possession in the midfield and he slides a pass down the left to Doucoure.
His low cross is poked away by Aguerd, with Harrison recovering it.
He moves the ball onto his left foot before blasting his shot high and wide.

Onana leads all Everton players in the Premier League this season for tackles (22), possession won (62), duels won (71) and fouls won (19), while he ranks second for aerials won (27) and passes (382), behind only James Tarkowski (30 and 386 respectively).
West Ham started the game brightly but are finding it difficult to create chances in the attacking third of the pitch.
They have retained possession in their own half but are passing it in front of Everton, who are keeping a strong defensive shape.
Aguerd sends a direct pass into Everton's half, with Bowen moving inside from the right to try and get onto the end of it.
However, Mykolenko shields it well and allows the ball to go back to Pickford.
Mykolenko is not being put under pressure on the left and he whips a cross into the box.
Calvert-Lewin runs back to get away from his marker before heading well over from inside the box.
Onana is on the floor and is receiving treatment after a strong tackle on Kudus.
However, after a short time, he returns to his feet and will be able to continue.
This match has struggled to get going in the attack and there has only been two shots on target.
Alvarez switches the ball over to the right, with Coufal bursting forward, but his cross goes into the gloves of Pickford.
There will be five minutes of additional time.
Bowen is fouled inside West Ham's half and Coufal tries to take it quickly.
Antonio rushes down the right, but the referee stops the game as the ball was still moving when Coufal kicked it.
Garner strolls down the left and is looking for options in the middle.
The midfielder then pokes it down the left to Mykolenko, but he puts too much on it and sends it out for a goal-kick.
HALF-TIME: WEST HAM 0-0 EVERTON
Harrison had the best chance to break the deadlock in a match that ends goalless at half-time.
West Ham started the game well and were attacking down the left at every opportunity.
Paqueta flicked the ball over the head of Patterson before driving a pass across to Bowen, who stroked his first-time effort wide.
Moments later, Everton had their best chance of the half.
Harrison won possession in the midfield and drove forward with it.
He had options to his left and right but struck his low strike straight at Areola.
Calvert-Lewin missed the target with a header, and Harrison blazed a shot high and wide from outside the box.
West Ham were the better team in the opening exchanges.
Kudus had a lot of nice touches in Everton's half, with Paqueta and Cresswell combing well down the left.
However, they seemed to lack energy as the half progressed and were being put under pressure by Everton.
As for the away side, they grew into the game.
Harrison has been positive on the wing and Mykolenko has delivered a few good crosses.
However, they will want to get more out of Calvert-Lewin, who has only had a couple of half chances to score.
Everton get the ball rolling again.
No changes at the break.
BLOCK! West Ham start the half brightly.
Paqueta brings the ball down well on the left and looks for Antonio in the middle.
Everton get it away, but the hosts recycle it well and Bowen receives it just inside the box.
He shifts it onto his left foot before curling an effort towards the goal that is blocked by Branthwaite.
Ward-Prowse gives away a free-kick just inside West Ham's half, allowing Everton to put the ball into the box.
Garner chips into a dangerous area and Tarkowski tries to attack it, but the hosts clear it away.
Harrison collects the ball well and plays a pass into the feet of Calvert-Lewin.
He uses his body to get past two defenders and finishes with composure.
GOALLL! CALVERT-LEWIN SCORES! 1-0 EVERTON! What a finish from Calvert-Lewin! Harrison has the ball on the edge of the box and he flicks a pass into the striker.
He goes past Zouma and Aguard and drives a shot across the goal and into the bottom corner.
Calvert-Lewin's goal is his 50th in the Premier League for Everton, becoming only the fourth Everton player to reach this milestone after Romelu Lukaku (68), Duncan Ferguson (60) and Tim Cahill (56).
OVER! Paqueta rolls past Garner on the left and lofts a cross towards Antonio.
Mykolenko heads it into the air and Bowen smashes over from a tight angle.
Ward-Prowse whips a cross from the right into the box.
Paqueta gets on the end of it, but he cannot direct his overhead kick towards the goal.
West Ham make a change.
Benrahma comes on for Antonio in the attack.
Bowen sends a cross into Kudus, but the former Ajax man cannot get the ball out of his feet.
Branthwaite flicks it away, but Bowen recovers it and plays it back to Alvarez, who shoots over.
SAVE! Everton should have doubled their advantage.
Calvert-Lewin flicks the ball into the path of Doucoure, who is one-on-one with Areola.
He goes low with his strike and Areola pushes it wide.
Cresswell is making his first start of the season and is struggling against Harrison.
The Everton winger is looking to go at him at every opportunity and is having a lot of joy down the right side.
Ward-Prowse and Cresswell are over a free-kick.
The former takes and whips a cross into the box.
Branthwaite heads it away, but Benrahma is there and he looks to put the ball back into the box.
McNeil blocks it and the hosts want a penalty for handball, but nothing is given.
McNeil strolls forward with possession inside West Ham's half and is not being put under pressure.
He blasts a powerful shot towards the goal that is pushed over by Areola.
Bowen wins a corner on the right and Ward-Prowse comes over to take it.
His outswinging cross is met by Aguard, who has his downward header blocked by Onana.
The hosts want a penalty as it hit the arm of the midfielder, but it was in a natural position.
Paqueta goes into the book for dissent.
He wanted a corner on the left after Garner blocked his cross, but a goal-kick was given as it came back off the West Ham man.
Everton have defended well in this game, but they still have plenty of work to do.
West Ham have scored in each of their last 11 Premier League games, including all nine this season.
Only in 2015-16 have they ever scored in each of their first 10 games from the start of a Premier League campaign.
Garner has possession on the left inside West Ham's half and attempts to whip a cross into the box.
The hosts get it away, but only as far as the Everton man.
He attempts to loop the ball across this time, but Areola catches it with ease.
West Ham make a change in the midfield.
Soucek replaces Ward-Prowse.
Coufal is tripped by Harrison, with the referee taking his time to give a free-kick.
Dyche is furious as Calvert-Lewin was breaking away.
Onana drives forward with the ball and slides a throughball into the path of Calvert-Lewin.
He springs behind West Ham's defence and crashes the bar with his strike.
The flag goes up for offside, but it was very tight.
Benrahma is shown a yellow card for a foul on Garner after he had initially lost possession.
SAVE! What a stop from Pickford! Coufal's cross is cleared away as far as Paqueta, who volleys a shot towards the goal.
Bowen flicks it into the path of Kudus, with the attacker having his attempt blocked by the goalkeeper at close range.
The flag then goes up for offside
West Ham commit men forward, with the hosts playing it around quickly in Everton's defensive third.
The ball drops to Paqueta, but he takes too long in possession, allowing Onana to make a vital tackle.
Paqueta is on the ball and he slides a throughball down the right to Kudus, who gets around the back of Everton's defence.
He attempts to cut it back to Bowen, but it goes behind the winger and through to Onana.
Alvarez goes into the book for a late slide tackle on Onana.
He will miss West Ham's game against Brentford.
West Ham are making a switch to try and force an equaliser.
Moyes adds another attacker to the mix, with Ings coming on for Cresswell.
SAVE! Aguerd strides down the left and chips a cross into the box.
However, it looks to be heading on target, forcing Pickford to rush back and push the ball over.
Everton make their first change of the game.
Chermiti is given a chance to make an impression up front and replaces Calvert-Lewin, who could have scored the winner with his goal earlier in the half.
SAVE! Pickford makes another strong stop.
Paqueta curls a first-time cross from the right towards Benrahma, who crashes a volley on target.
Pickford gets behind it and pushes his powerful strike away.
There will be six minutes of additional time.
Paqueta switches the play from right to left, with Benrahma taking the ball down well.
He attempts to beat Patterson, but the right-back makes a good tackle.
The Everton man has had an excellent half.
The West Ham players are furious.
The game is stopped with McNeil on the floor.
The Everton man stays on the floor for a short period before returning to his feet.
Benrahma has possession on the left and goes from side to side to try and beat Harrison, but the winger stays with him and pokes it away.
West Ham had players in the box waiting for a cross.
CHANCE! Ings drifts over to the left to receive the ball.
He has options in the middle and attempts to loop a cross into a dangerous area but sends it straight into the gloves of Pickford.
Kudus helps the ball down the right to Bowen, who tries to send a cross into the box.
However, it takes a deflection off an Everton defender and into the path of Pickford.
FULL-TIME: WEST HAM 0-1 EVERTON
Calvert-Lewin scored his 50th Premier League goal to help Everton beat West Ham at London Stadium.
The hosts had the first chance of the match.
Paqueta flicked the ball over the head of Patterson and drilled a pass across to Bowen, but he blasted his shot wide.
Harrison had a shot saved by Areola before an entertaining second half.
Bowen had a goal-bound effort blocked by Branthwaite, with Everton scoring soon after.
Harrison found Calvert-Lewin, who rolled past two defenders before driving his strike across the goal and into the bottom corner.
Bowen smashed a shot over from a tight angle before Doucoure had a golden opportunity.
He got onto the end of a clever flick from Calvert-Lewin, but his effort was pushed wide by Areola.
Paqueta then found Benrahma with an excellent cross for West Ham's final chance.
However, his powerful volley was stopped by Pickford.
Attention now turns to the EFL Cup.
West Ham host Arsenal and Everton welcome Burnley.
That's all for today, goodbye.
